instruction: Treat a base template `/home/user/Desktop/print_base.inp` as the starting point. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/print.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/print.inp. - Output displacement only for free-end nodes - Output stress only for the center element - Define node set (`2,3,6,7`) - Define element set (`1`) 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `print.dat`: - Extract node-2 `UY` and element-1 Mises stress - Count node output records excluding `Tip_Nodes` - Count element output records excluding `Center_Element` - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `tip_u2,center_mises,other_node_records,other_element_records` [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. On this machine, use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.
